```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# Improve digit display and NA display for kable tables
options(scipen = 1, knitr.kable.NA = "")

# Load necessary packages
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(mdsr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(lubridate)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

#upload csv
OECD <- read_csv("data/OECD.TAD.ADM,DSD_QDD_TAD_EXP_RESTRIC@DF_QDD_TAD_EXP_RESTRIC,3.0,filtered,2026-10-27 21-23-49.csv")

#wrangle data so that each case represents a single policy
OECD_policies <- OECD |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(REF_AREA, `Reference area`, COMMODITY, Commodity, POLICY_TYPE, `Policy type`, POLICY_VARIATION, `Policy changes`, TIME_PERIOD),
    names_from = POLICY_DESCRIPTION,
    values_from = OBS_VALUE
    ) |>
  mutate(
    Id = row_number(),
    Interval = interval(DATI, END)
         )

unique(OECD_policies$`Policy type`)

#wrangle data so that each case represents a country at a certain year (how many restrictions do they have actively imposed on them at the time?)
OECD_countryDates <- OECD_policies |>
  group_by(REF_AREA, )
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
